finding.guards_checked: login_required enforces session presence only. No current-password or re-auth check, no CSRF token, no request-body password. SameSite and CSRF middleware not visible in repo.

verdict.guard_found: login_required (routes.py:8-16) aborts 401 when "uid" is not in the session (line 11-12), which blocks anonymous callers only. It checks nothing about CSRF, re-authentication, or the current password. No CSRF middleware or token check is in the repo. set_password (routes.py:52-53) is a bare `pass` stub.
verdict.reason: Every trace line matches routes.py: the POST at line 41 is guarded only by login_required (lines 11-12), and change_password at line 44 calls set_password(g.uid, "hunter2") with no current-password check, no CSRF token, and no request input. Any logged-in session can trigger it, and a cross-site request would also work if the session cookie is sent cross-site, which the repo does not show. The HIGH severity is overstated: the sink at routes.py:52-53 is a no-op stub here, and the cross-site path depends on cookie SameSite settings that are outside the repo.
